Core Arrival point prediction.limitations: Point estimates only; does not provide uncertainty distributions; evaluated on 2016-2022 rolling folds.
Core Arrival point prediction.allowed_claims: Core arrival point prediction models (Linear, RF, HGB, XGBoost, Weighted Ensemble) evaluated across 4 rolling folds under signed ARR_DELAY at T-2h without weather or departure leakage.
Core Arrival point prediction.forbidden_claims: Unconditionally dominates all operational metrics; flawless prediction.

Core Arrival probabilistic prediction.limitations: Role separation strictly enforced: P4 provides continuous Student-T density (empirical calibration not separately certified); P5 provides discrete quantiles only (continuous density and exact NLL not available).
Core Arrival probabilistic prediction.allowed_claims: Probabilistic candidates evaluated on rolling folds; P4 provides continuous Student-T density; P5 provides quantile forecasts.
Core Arrival probabilistic prediction.forbidden_claims: P5 provides continuous density or PIT; P4 is an empirically certified calibrated distribution.

Auxiliary Departure.limitations: Isolated exploration; strictly quarantined from core arrival pipeline; zero feed into arrival delay or downstream solver.
Auxiliary Departure.allowed_claims: Auxiliary departure delay is a standalone benchmark not used in arrival prediction or gate assignment.
Auxiliary Departure.forbidden_claims: Joint arrival-departure optimization; departure delay feeds arrival gate solver.

Weather.limitations: Banned from Core Arrival by V4 invariant #1 to avoid point-in-time leakage and maintain clean operational boundaries.
Weather.allowed_claims: Weather features are excluded from Core Arrival to maintain invariant and prevent lookahead bias.
Weather.forbidden_claims: Real-time METAR/TAF weather feeds core arrival models.

Flight Chain.limitations: Reconstructed inbound chain features subject to tail number availability and historical schedule consistency.
Flight Chain.allowed_claims: Inbound aircraft flight chain features reconstructed using point-in-time schedule logic.
Flight Chain.forbidden_claims: 100% complete chain tracking across all carriers.

Temporal governance.limitations: 2024 was historically accessed during initial exploratory phases, so it cannot be claimed as 'unseen' or 'untouched'.
Temporal governance.allowed_claims: 2016-2022 rolling development; 2023 model selection; 2024 evaluated strictly post-freeze under POST_HOLDOUT protocol with zero parameter adaptation.
Temporal governance.forbidden_claims: 2024 is an untouched, pristine, never-before-seen blind test dataset.

Statistical inference.limitations: Day-cluster bootstrap on FL_DATE across 48 families; paired comparisons valid only for models evaluated on identical test slices.
Statistical inference.allowed_claims: Multiplicity-adjusted inference with Holm-Bonferroni FWER control establishes Linear and Weighted Ensemble show no statistically significant difference in point accuracy (adjusted p > 0.05), while both beat XGBoost.
Statistical inference.forbidden_claims: Unadjusted p < 0.001 significance; universal statistical superiority.

Point model selection.limitations: 2023 development selection slice ties Ridge and Ensemble within 0.10 min band (|Delta| = 0.00045 min). 2024 post-holdout is not tied (|Delta| = 0.4050 min). No single overall champion.
Point model selection.allowed_claims: Ridge and Ensemble are co-champions on 2023 selection slice under 0.10 min indifference band.
Point model selection.forbidden_claims: Single overall point champion; Ridge dominates all years.

Probabilistic model selection.limitations: Role separation: P5 selects for discrete quantiles/pinball loss; P4 selects for continuous parametric density.
Probabilistic model selection.allowed_claims: P5 selected for discrete interval evaluation; P4 selected for continuous density modeling.
Probabilistic model selection.forbidden_claims: Single overall probabilistic winner; P5 dominates continuous metrics.

Synthetic Turn.limitations: Turnaround durations generated from synthetic distribution models, not real-time airline ramp data.
Synthetic Turn.allowed_claims: Turn durations simulated under controlled operational scenarios.
Synthetic Turn.forbidden_claims: Real-world ground turnaround measurements at ATL.

Gate Simulation.limitations: Bounded to synthetic airfield scenarios with fixed contact/remote gates; operations strictly under SCALAR_FORECAST_IMPACT.
Gate Simulation.allowed_claims: Gate assignment evaluated under simulated scenarios with 0 hard constraint violations.
Gate Simulation.forbidden_claims: Field-deployed gate management system; operational dollar savings.

Greedy.limitations: Ultra-fast deterministic heuristic (<2ms); susceptible to local optima.
Greedy.allowed_claims: Fast baseline solver achieving feasible assignments with higher objective penalties than CP-SAT.

CP-SAT.limitations: Bounded to 2.0s time limit per scenario.
CP-SAT.allowed_claims: Exact constraint programming solver achieving champion objective (7167.17 mean) under 2.0s budget with 0 hard constraint violations.
CP-SAT.forbidden_claims: Proven global optimum for unbounded time.

SA.limitations: Time-bounded simulated annealing (2.0s budget); achieves 7167.88 mean objective.
SA.allowed_claims: Metaheuristic solver achieving feasible solutions close to CP-SAT under identical 2.0s compute budget.
SA.forbidden_claims: Strictly superior to mathematical programming solvers.

CP-SAT + SA.limitations: Equal compute budget allocation (1.0s CP-SAT + 1.0s SA = 2.0s); SA post-refinement yields 0.0 marginal improvement over standalone CP-SAT.
CP-SAT + SA.allowed_claims: Hybrid solver achieves 7167.17 mean objective under 2.0s total budget, matching CP-SAT with 0 hard violations.
CP-SAT + SA.forbidden_claims: Hybrid significantly outperforms standalone CP-SAT under equal compute budget.

Monte Carlo.limitations: Grid evaluation across N in {100, 250, 500, 1000, 2500}; CRN variance reduction not established; N=500 is an operational choice.
Monte Carlo.allowed_claims: Standard error follows empirical s/sqrt(N) convergence across evaluated grid points.
Monte Carlo.forbidden_claims: CRN reduces variance by 82.4%; N=500 is mathematically optimal.

Reproducibility.limitations: Certified With Limitations under contained specification; historical data access noted.
Reproducibility.allowed_claims: System certified with limitations using cryptographic freeze manifests and deterministic seeds.
Reproducibility.forbidden_claims: 100% reproducible; error-free research; universal replication on any OS without specified environment.

Certification tests.limitations: Hardened tests verify byte-level SHA256 hashes, exact claims, and protocol invariants.
Certification tests.allowed_claims: Test suite rigorously enforces cryptographic lineage, temporal governance, and claim boundaries.
Certification tests.forbidden_claims: Tests alone substitute for empirical domain validity.
